1.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
1.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,

2.web: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.
2.asv: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath an issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.

3.web: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.
3.asv: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.

4.web: “‘Every bed whereon he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.
4.asv: Every bed whereon he that hath the issue lieth shall be unclean; and everything whereon he sitteth shall be unclean.

5.web: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
5.asv: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

6.web: He who sits on anything whereon the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
6.asv: And he that sitteth on anything whereon he that hath the issue sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

7.web: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
7.asv: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

8.web: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
8.asv: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

9.web: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.
9.asv: And what saddle soever he that hath the issue rideth upon shall be unclean.

10.web: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
10.asv: And whosoever toucheth anything that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

11.web: “‘Whoever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
11.asv: And whomsoever he that hath the issue toucheth, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

12.web: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
12.asv: And the earthen vessel, which he that hath the issue toucheth, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

13.web: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
13.asv: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue, then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

14.web: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before Yahweh to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest:
14.asv: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and come before Jehovah unto the door of the tent of meeting, and give them unto the priest:

15.web: and the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh for his discharge.
15.asv: and the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah for his issue.

16.web: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.
16.asv: And if any man’s seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.

17.web: Every garment, and every skin, whereon the semen is, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.
17.asv: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.

18.web: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.
18.asv: The woman also with whom a man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.

19.web: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days: and whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.
19.asv: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.

20.web: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.
20.asv: And everything that she lieth upon in her impurity shall be unclean: everything also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.

21.web: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
21.asv: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

22.web: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
22.asv: And whosoever toucheth anything that she sitteth upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

23.web: If it is on the bed, or on anything whereon she sits, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.
23.asv: And if it be on the bed, or on anything whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.

24.web: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed whereon he lies shall be unclean.
24.asv: And if any man lie with her, and her impurity be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.

25.web: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period; all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period: she is unclean.
25.asv: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days not in the time of her impurity, or if she have an issue beyond the time of her impurity; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness she shall be as in the days of her impurity: she is unclean.

26.web: Every bed whereon she lies all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period: and everything whereon she sits shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.
26.asv: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her impurity: and everything whereon she sitteth shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her impurity.

27.web: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.
27.asv: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

28.web: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
28.asv: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

29.web: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.
29.asv: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tent of meeting.

30.web: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Yahweh for the uncleanness of her discharge.
30.asv: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Jehovah for the issue of her uncleanness.

31.web: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is in their midst.’”
31.asv: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is in the midst of them.

32.web: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean thereby;
32.asv: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed of copulation goeth from him, so that he is unclean thereby;

33.web: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.
33.asv: and of her that is sick with her impurity, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
